mapper.select: SELECT r.reportIdx, r.reporterIdx, r.reportedUserIdx, r.domainType, r.targetIdx, r.reportType, r.reportContent, TO_CHAR(r.reportDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reportDate, r.processStatus, TO_CHAR(r.processDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS processDate, r.adminMemo, u1.userId AS reporterId, u1.nickname AS reporterName, u2.userId AS reportedUserId, u2.nickname AS reportedUserName FROM adminReport r JOIN users u1 ON r.reporterIdx = u1.userIdx JOIN users u2 ON r.reportedUserIdx = u2.userIdx WHERE r.reportIdx = #{reportIdx}
SELECT reportedUserIdx FROM adminReport WHERE reportIdx = #{reportIdx}
SELECT reporterIdx FROM adminReport WHERE reportIdx = #{reportIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE community SET is_hidden = 1 WHERE community_id = #{targetIdx}
UPDATE community_reply SET is_hidden = 1 WHERE reply_id = #{targetIdx}
